plan.title: SHG Loan Repayment & Purpose Analysis
plan.subtitle: Overview of loan disbursements, repayment status distribution, and purpose breakdown across blocks.

panels.title: Total Loan Amount (Rs)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Repayment Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average Loan Amount by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", AVG("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS avg_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top Blocks by Overdue Loans
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS overdue_count, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS overdue_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
